results.ask: How do I set polarity for flux-cored? Which socket does the ground clamp go in?
results.text:
Flux-cored uses **DCEN** (direct current, electrode negative) — no shielding gas needed:

- **Ground Clamp Cable → Positive (+) socket**
- **Wire Feed Power Cable → Negative (–) socket**

Twist both cables clockwise all the way to lock them in [p.13].

This is the opposite of solid-wire MIG polarity, so if you switch between flux-cored and gas-shielded MIG wire, swap these two cables.One gotcha specific to flux-cored: this is the setup most people get backwards because it's the reverse of solid-wire MIG. Double-check both sockets before striking an arc — wrong polarity here shows up later as porosity or a wandering, unstable arc [p.43].
